items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: The OK was with Santo, Rap, Paul... Steve Loiskaner, Freddie Newman, piano, and Chink... And a tenor? Lester. Lester Bouchon. Yeah. And the drums? August Schillang.

ctx.x: I was wondering, you told me once, uh, when I was fishing in the hospital about him being sick so long, and you'd go by and see him all the time.

Yeah, well that's after he quit playing. Mm-hmm. But the, the, the, the thing, uh, the thing that, that most people don't know about Hardy, the first time he left here, he left here with, with Blossom Sealy. With he, Santo Bacora, Rapolo, and Blossom Sealy's, uh, Blossom Sealy's husband, whose name was, oh, he later got to be a pretty big man around Chicago and New York. Uh, I think he was, I think he was a hop head, I'm not sure.
Maybe, uh, Ray Lopez used to work with them, too, in the East. Maybe you don't mention his name, though.
